description: This file contains the 'Article' model class for the OpenCart CMS, responsible for interacting with articles in the database, including retrieval, search, comments, and ratings functionalities.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Model class for managing articles, comments, and ratings in the OpenCart CMS.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Fetches a single article record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Retrieves multiple articles based on filter criteria, with caching support.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating value for a specified article.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with an article.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Creates a new comment for an article and returns its ID.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating for a specific article comment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Fetches comments related to an article with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Counts total comments for an article based on filters.

methods.name: addRating
methods.description: Adds a rating for a specific article comment.

methods.name: deleteRating
methods.description: Removes a rating record associated with a comment.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating statistics for an article or comment.
